threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still instinctively check your phone for tube updates when you hear a train rumble, instead of just bracing for delays like the rest of us.
Last night on the 68, a guy serenaded the whole bus with a ukulele version of 'Wonderwall.' Even the driver was tapping the wheel!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Caught a glimpse of a street artist painting a mural while locals gathered for impromptu karaoke. That's when it hit me - this is home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can order a currywurst at 3 AM, and the stand guy will still chat with you about the latest club openings. That’s Berlin hustle.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by how they never bother to find a new route when BART's down. They just roll with the bus delays like it’s another Wednesday.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus with a broken air conditioning in this heat. The driver just shrugged and said, 'Welcome to San Francisco.' Only here can discomfort feel like home.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all of Gràcia is a constant fiesta, but many locals just want their bocata and a quiet corner to enjoy it.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a newcomer by their puzzlement at the lack of a queue at the bakery—natives know that the best pastries disappear fast.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the tube' instead of 'London Overground'—that tells everyone you’re a newcomer, mate.
Last night on the 59, a guy serenaded two women with an off-key rendition of 'Wonderwall.' They looked horrified but clapped anyway. Classic Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I realized I was home when I saw the old man on Hermannstraße giving fresh flowers to the kids at the tram stop, right before the BVG strike.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find an open-air cinema that screens cult films in abandoned buildings, surrounded by graffiti art. It’s pure magic.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know they’re from SF if they can name at least three burrito spots where the salsa isn’t just a red blob. It's a serious test of authenticity.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy playing a grand piano on the 6 bus yesterday. People were singing along, totally forgot about the delays and crowd. Pure SF magic.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just about Gaudí, but the real soul is in the little family-run bars where locals gather for vermut, not selfies.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they still ask for directions to the nearest metro when they're just a block away from a major station.
